summaryZh: Rivera-Nieves 实验室研究免疫细胞如何定向归巢到不同肠段，以解释炎症性肠病的区域分布并改善治疗策略。研究结合多类炎症性肠病小鼠模型和患者来源样本。
researchQuestions: 免疫细胞如何特异性地归巢至不同肠段？
methods: 化学诱导与免疫操纵小鼠模型

evidence.quote: Lab Members Dr. Jesus Rivera-Nieves Principal Investigator
The goal of our research if to further understand how are immune cells to home specifically to distinct intestinal segments

We utilize a variety of mouse models of IBD from simple chemically-induced injury models (e.g. DSS) to immunologically-manipulated models (i.e. CD45Rb high transfer) to spontaneous chronic models of colitis and Crohn's-like ileitis (i.e. TNFΔARE, SAMP1/Yit) and patient-derived samples.
